verdict.rationale: The pricing-page evidence covers only plan features: 100 projects, unlimited team members, and a free tier with no credit card. No published per-unit rates for compute, storage, or traffic appear in the pack. Community comments mention CPU-based pricing and plan price levels but do not document per-unit rates that would let a founder predict a bill.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing for compute, storage, and traffic lets me predict my bill before committing
